description: How a 10-K section's language drifts over several years: each year's change from the year before (the Lazy Prices measure), hedging and adverse words, readability, and how much it says about a theme you name and how that wording moves, with flags for the years and themes that moved most.

section.description: The 10-K item to follow: "risk factors" (default), "md&a", "business", "market risk"...

theme.description: A phrase to follow through the years, e.g. "supply chain", "tariff", "China".

years.description: Annual reports to compare, newest first; default 5.

name: filing_drift

outputSchema.description: rows are annual reports, newest first, in the order of columns; flags are plain sentences.

title: Language drift across filings
